  "title": "Supply Planning & DRP Lead",
  "description": "Promasidor - We are an African company proud of our heritage and totally committed to the continent. We manufacture, market and sell unique brands which bring practicality and pleasure to millions of consumers across Africa.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Supply Planning &amp; DRP Lead

Job Location: Oshodi - Isolo, Lagos

Job Purpose


	The Supply Planning &amp; DRP Lead is a critical individual contributor role responsible for ensuring that Promasidor&#39;s supply plans, production schedules, and distribution requirements are optimally aligned to meet customer service targets, minimise supply risk, and drive cost efficiency.
	The role sits at the intersection of demand, supply, and logistics &mdash; translating the agreed S&amp;OP volume plan into executable production and distribution plans across Promasidor&#39;s factory network and warehousing footprint.


Key Responsibilities
Production Planning:


	Develop and maintain a rolling 13-week master production schedule (MPS) aligned to the agreed S&amp;OP volume plan.
	Translate unconstrained demand forecasts into constrained production plans, factoring in capacity, material availability, and inventory targets.
	Coordinate with Factory Managers and Engineering teams to incorporate planned maintenance, OEE constraints, and changeover requirements into the production schedule.
	Lead the weekly Supply Planning Meeting &mdash; preparing the supply deck, facilitating the discussion, and driving decisions on supply gaps and trade-offs.
	Monitor plan adherence (Production Conformance %) and escalate deviations with proposed corrective actions.
	Manage short-term production trade-offs across SKUs and categories, prioritising based on customer service risk and margin impact.


Capacity Management:


	Maintain a dynamic capacity model (by line, by factory) covering a 12-month rolling horizon.
	Identify capacity bottlenecks and surplus proactively, initiating investment cases or production-shift proposals as required.
	Evaluate and recommend make-vs-buy or co-manufacturing options where in-house capacity is constrained.
	Provide capacity inputs to the S&amp;OP process for medium- and long-term investment decisions.
	Collaborate with the Engineering team on OEE improvement initiatives and track the supply impact of capacity projects.
	Flag capacity risks related to new product development (NPD), promotions, and seasonal demand peaks to the broader S&amp;OP team.


Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP):


	Own the Distribution Requirements Planning process &mdash; ensuring optimal stock positioning across the depot network and external warehouses to meet OTIF targets.
	Set and review stock norms (min/max/safety stock) for each distribution node based on demand variability, lead times, and service-level targets.
	Coordinate finished goods deployment from factories/primary warehouses to secondary depots and 3PL sites.
	Monitor and report on days cover, stock-in-trade levels, and depot inventory health across all locations.
	Identify and drive resolution of distribution bottlenecks &mdash; including logistics constraints, slow-moving stock (SLOB), and warehouse capacity issues.
	Align distribution plans with the Sales and Commercial teams to support promotional activities, new listings, and key customer commitments.


S&amp;OP Process Contribution:


	Prepare and present the Supply Planning pack for the monthly S&amp;OP Supply Meeting and DSR (Demand Supply Reconciliation).
	Ensure all supply-side inputs (constrained plan, capacity profile, supply risks and opportunities) are submitted to the S&amp;OP Manager on time.
	Support the identification of gap-closure options (supply pull-forward, inter-depot transfers, external procurement) for DSR and ExCo S&amp;OP.
	Maintain the integrity of supply-side assumptions within the S&amp;OP planning tool or ERP.


Data, Systems &amp; Continuous Improvement:


	Champion data quality and planning discipline within the supply planning team and across supply chain functions.
	Lead or support WMS, ERP, and planning tool implementation/optimisation projects as required.
	Develop and maintain standard planning templates, dashboards, and KPI reports for supply performance tracking.
	Identify and implement process improvements to reduce planning cycle times, improve plan accuracy, and minimise waste.
	Conduct root-cause analysis on supply failures and drive corrective actions to prevent recurrence.


Requirements
Experience:


	Minimum 2&ndash;4 years of progressive experience in supply planning, production planning, or DRP within an FMCG, manufacturing, or consumer goods environment.
	Demonstrated experience managing multi-site or multi-SKU production schedules in a fast-paced environment.
	Hands-on experience with DRP, safety stock modelling, and distribution network planning.
	Active participation in S&amp;OP processes &mdash; ideally as a supply-side owner or lead.
	Experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or equivalent) and advanced planning tools is required.
	Exposure to WMS implementation or optimisation projects is an advantage.

Supply Planning & DRP Lead Job at Promasidor




        
    

        
        Promasidor - We are an African company proud of our heritage and totally committed to the continent. We manufacture, market and sell unique brands which bring practicality and pleasure to millions of consumers across Africa.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Supply Planning & DRP Lead

Job Location: Oshodi - Isolo, Lagos

Job Purpose
     

            
    




	The Supply Planning & DRP Lead is a critical individual contributor role responsible for ensuring that Promasidor's supply plans, production schedules, and distribution requirements are optimally aligned to meet customer service targets, minimise supply risk, and drive cost efficiency.
	The role sits at the intersection of demand, supply, and logistics — translating the agreed S&OP volume plan into executable production and distribution plans across Promasidor's factory network and warehousing footprint.


Key Responsibilities
Production Planning:


	Develop and maintain a rolling 13-week master production schedule (MPS) aligned to the agreed S&OP volume plan.
	Translate unconstrained demand forecasts into constrained production plans, factoring in capacity, material availability, and inventory targets.
	Coordinate with Factory Managers and Engineering teams to incorporate planned maintenance, OEE constraints, and changeover requirements into the production schedule.
	Lead the weekly Supply Planning Meeting — preparing the supply deck, facilitating the discussion, and driving decisions on supply gaps and trade-offs.
	Monitor plan adherence (Production Conformance %) and escalate deviations with proposed corrective actions.
	Manage short-term production trade-offs across SKUs and categories, prioritising based on customer service risk and margin impact.


Capacity Management:


	Maintain a dynamic capacity model (by line, by factory) covering a 12-month rolling horizon.
	Identify capacity bottlenecks and surplus proactively, initiating investment cases or production-shift proposals as required.
	Evaluate and recommend make-vs-buy or co-manufacturing options where in-house capacity is constrained.
	Provide capacity inputs to the S&OP process for medium- and long-term investment decisions.
	Collaborate with the Engineering team on OEE improvement initiatives and track the supply impact of capacity projects.
	Flag capacity risks related to new product development (NPD), promotions, and seasonal demand peaks to the broader S&OP team.


Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP):


	Own the Distribution Requirements Planning process — ensuring optimal stock positioning across the depot network and external warehouses to meet OTIF targets.
	Set and review stock norms (min/max/safety stock) for each distribution node based on demand variability, lead times, and service-level targets.
	Coordinate finished goods deployment from factories/primary warehouses to secondary depots and 3PL sites.
	Monitor and report on days cover, stock-in-trade levels, and depot inventory health across all locations.
	Identify and drive resolution of distribution bottlenecks — including logistics constraints, slow-moving stock (SLOB), and warehouse capacity issues.
	Align distribution plans with the Sales and Commercial teams to support promotional activities, new listings, and key customer commitments.


S&OP Process Contribution:


	Prepare and present the Supply Planning pack for the monthly S&OP Supply Meeting and DSR (Demand Supply Reconciliation).
	Ensure all supply-side inputs (constrained plan, capacity profile, supply risks and opportunities) are submitted to the S&OP Manager on time.
	Support the identification of gap-closure options (supply pull-forward, inter-depot transfers, external procurement) for DSR and ExCo S&OP.
	Maintain the integrity of supply-side assumptions within the S&OP planning tool or ERP.


Data, Systems & Continuous Improvement:


	Champion data quality and planning discipline within the supply planning team and across supply chain functions.
	Lead or support WMS, ERP, and planning tool implementation/optimisation projects as required.
	Develop and maintain standard planning templates, dashboards, and KPI reports for supply performance tracking.
	Identify and implement process improvements to reduce planning cycle times, improve plan accuracy, and minimise waste.
	Conduct root-cause analysis on supply failures and drive corrective actions to prevent recurrence.


Requirements
Experience:


	Minimum 2–4 years of progressive experience in supply planning, production planning, or DRP within an FMCG, manufacturing, or consumer goods environment.
	Demonstrated experience managing multi-site or multi-SKU production schedules in a fast-paced environment.
	Hands-on experience with DRP, safety stock modelling, and distribution network planning.
	Active participation in S&OP processes — ideally as a supply-side owner or lead.
	Experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or equivalent) and advanced planning tools is required.
	Exposure to WMS implementation or optimisation projects is an advantage.

General Manager Job at Valuemart




        
    

        
        Valuemart is a dynamic retail and hospitality company committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences through quality products, excellent service, and innovative business solutions. With operations spanning retail, bakery, restaurant, and café services, we pride ourselves on creating value for our customers, empowering our employees, and contributing positively to the communities we serve.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: General Manager

Job Location: Maitama, Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Purpose
     

            
    




	Responsible for the overall management of the hospitality business, ensuring smooth operations, excellent customer service, staff productivity, cost control, profitability, and compliance with company standards.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage and supervise daily operations across all departments.
	Lead, motivate, and monitor staff performance.
	Ensure excellent customer service and resolve complaints.
	Monitor sales, revenue, expenses, budgets, and profitability.
	Control food costs, stock, wastage, and operational expenses.
	Ensure hygiene, safety, cleanliness, and quality standards are maintained.
	Coordinate procurement, maintenance, security, and facility management.
	Develop strategies to increase sales and improve business performance.
	Enforce company policies, procedures, and disciplinary standards.
	Prepare regular operational and performance reports for management.
	Work closely with HR, Accounts, Audit, Procurement, and departmental heads.
	Identify operational problems and implement timely solutions.


Qualifications


	Interested candidates should possess a Bachelor's Degree with 5 years of experience.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Procurement Officer Job at 21Search Limited




        
    

        
        21search - Our client, a leading manufacturing company, is recruiting suitable candidates to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Procurement Officer

Job Location: Oshodi, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking a Procurement Officer to join our Procurement team and support efficient, cost effective, and timely sourcing of materials, equipment, spare parts, and services.


Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Plan and execute procurement activities based on business and production requirements.
	Source, evaluate, and manage local and international suppliers.
	Obtain quotations, compare prices, negotiate favourable terms, and prepare Purchase Orders.
	Monitor orders and ensure timely delivery of materials and equipment.
	Support inventory management and prevent stockouts or excess inventory.
	Identify cost saving opportunities while maintaining quality standards.
	Ensure purchased materials meet approved specifications.
	Maintain accurate procurement records and supplier documentation.
	Monitor supplier performance and resolve quality, pricing, and delivery issues.
	Collaborate with Production, Engineering, Finance, Quality Assurance, and Stores.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree or HND in Purchasing & Supply, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Economics, Logistics, Engineering, or a related field.
	3 to 5 years of procurement experience in a manufacturing environment.
	Experience sourcing engineering spare parts, production materials, or industrial equipment is an added advantage.
	Strong knowledge of procurement, supplier management, inventory management, and contract negotiation.
	Experience with ERP procurement systems and Microsoft Office Suite.
	CIPSMN or CIPS membership is an added advantage.


Remuneration
N250,000 – N300,000 Gross Monthly.
